cases.name: Margit Schuller
cases.about: She was a native of Hungary, and her husband was in the Navy and on assignment in California at the time. A dedicated cardiac nurse, she lived and worked in Hungary before marrying Jozsef (YOH-zhef) Schuller in Székesfehérvár (SEH-kehsh-feh-HAIR-vahr), about 40 miles west of Budapest in Hungary. The couple welcomed a daughter before immigrating to the United States on April 15, 1982.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY SOLVED; PENDING
cases.narrative: Her 12-year-old daughter found her lying under a tree in a pool of blood after going to check on her mother, who had not returned from doing laundry.
